name: CEKD
recent: CEKD 近期通过全资子公司 Sharp Die Cutting Mould 以 RM15 million 现金收购位于 Shah Alam 的一幅工业地及厂房，交易尚待州政府同意。公司同时已完成以 RM3 million 现金收购 Shin Fuji Labels 全部股权。
notable: 全资子公司 Sharp Die Cutting Mould 与 Maxvic 签署买卖协议，以 RM15 million 现金收购一幅 99 年租赁地及厂房。
公司以 RM3 million 现金完成收购 Shin Fuji Labels 全部股权。
risks: RM15 million 物业收购需取得州政府同意，预计在协议日期起 4 个月内取得。

recent_en: CEKD is acquiring an industrial land and factory in Shah Alam for RM15 million cash via its wholly-owned subsidiary Sharp Die Cutting Mould, subject to state authority consent. The company has also completed the RM3 million cash acquisition of the entire equity interest in Shin Fuji Labels.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Sharp Die Cutting Mould signed an SPA with Maxvic to acquire a 99-year leasehold land and factory for RM15 million cash.
The company completed the RM3 million cash acquisition of the entire equity interest in Shin Fuji Labels.
risks_en: The RM15 million property acquisition is subject to state authority consent, expected within 4 months from the agreement date.
